title: llm-kit project model personal layer, version 1
description: The personal layer beside the tracked file (default .llm-kit/models.local.yaml) after YAML parsing. Written in llm-scripting-kit.json-schema-subset/v1. It holds no catalog: each selection is checked against the tracked file's catalog with the reader rules of llm-kit.project-models/v1. Contract and shared cases: docs/reference/llm-kit-formats.md.

selection.description: A selection key's model (a tracked catalog id) and effort. An omitted effort and a null effort mean the same: no effort.
